title: appbox story map (intake/map.json)
$comment: DRAFT, Slice B1. Describes what appboxd/lib/intake_artifacts.dart emitStoryMap WRITES, not what any loader enforces: nothing reads this file at runtime, exactly like skills/appbox-intake/intake.schema.json (see the note at intake.dart:70) — so it can drift invisibly. Change emitStoryMap and you must change this by hand. Do NOT build a loader for it on the strength of its existing; the Dart emitter is the executable spec and this is the human-readable one.

stories.$comment: COUNT of stories assigned to this release, not the stories themselves. Computed at emit time so a reader is a dumb field selector.

items.$comment: OPEN on purpose. appbox-story-mapper owns this document; intake only republishes it. A closed set here would delete a field the owning skill legitimately added — task #29's failure mode.
No surfaceId. Slice B decision (2026-08-02): no JS does that name-matching today, so it would be a stored field with no reader and no test, and a wrong value would go unnoticed. Additive later.

byRelease.$comment: Release name -> story count, key-sorted so the bytes depend on content and not on story order.

counts.$comment: Open: a priority word outside must/should/could is reported under its own key rather than silently zeroed. Intake does not own the story-mapper's vocabulary, and dropping a bucket would hide stories.

statuses.$comment: Story id -> review state (done, in-progress, blocked, ...). AUTHORED IN THE STUDIO, never by intake: emitStoryMap always yields {} and mergeStoryMap re-unites it with the prior file at the write step. Orphan ids (story renamed away) are kept — see the mergeStoryMap doc comment.

provenance.$comment: The same three values as intake.schema.json. There is no fourth — unstated means 'inferred'.

contentId.$comment: CONTENT-derived: slug(epic) / slug(epic).slug(feature) / slug(epic).slug(feature).slug(story), with a -2/-3 suffix only on genuine collisions. Never sequential. Sequential ids (the studio seed's s-1..s-34) renumber every later story when one is inserted, moving statuses and review comments onto the wrong rows.

priority.$comment: MoSCoW by convention (must/should/could), but NOT a closed enum: seedFromBrief accepts whatever a hand-written story-map table says, and a schema stricter than that path would split the two front ends.
